title: CourseFaq standalone API routes for course edit page
content:
The course edit page needs individual CRUD for course-specific FAQs (CourseFaq). Currently FAQs are only manageable via nested replace-all on the course. Add dedicated routes under /api/admin/courses/[courseId]/faqs.

Routes:
- GET /api/admin/courses/[courseId]/faqs — list all FAQs for a course, ordered by sortOrder
- POST /api/admin/courses/[courseId]/faqs — create a new FAQ for a course (Zod validated)
- PATCH /api/admin/courses/[courseId]/faqs/[faqId] — update a single FAQ (Zod partial)
- DELETE /api/admin/courses/[courseId]/faqs/[faqId] — delete a single FAQ

Zod schemas: append courseFaqCreateSchema/courseFaqUpdateSchema to src/lib/validation/course.ts

Admin auth (session.user.role === 'ADMIN') required on all routes.

The frontend is located at /[locale]/admin/courses/[id]/edit.
acceptance: GET /api/admin/courses/[courseId]/faqs returns all FAQs for a course ordered by sortOrder
PATCH /api/admin/courses/[courseId]/faqs/[faqId] updates a FAQ, returns 404 if not found
DELETE /api/admin/courses/[courseId]/faqs/[faqId] deletes a FAQ, returns 404 if not found
Zod validation returns 400 with fieldErrors on invalid input
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
verification: npm run typecheck && curl GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE with valid admin token
